from pathlib import Path
import struct
b=Path('sensor_data.bin').read_bytes()
print('len',len(b))
o=16
i=0
while o < len(b):
    if b[o:o+4] == b'END!':
        print('footer at', o, 'crc32_le=', hex(struct.unpack_from('<I', b, o+4)[0]), 'tail=', b[o+8:].hex())
        break
    ts,=struct.unpack_from('<Q', b, o); o+=8
    level=b[o]; o+=1
    slen=b[o]; o+=1
    src=b[o:o+slen].decode('utf-8','replace'); o+=slen
    mlen,=struct.unpack_from('<H', b, o); o+=2
    msg=b[o:o+mlen].decode('utf-8','replace'); o+=mlen
    i+=1
    print(i, 'ts',ts,'level',level,'slen',slen,'mlen',mlen,'src',src,'msg',repr(msg),'nextoff',hex(o))
print('parsed',i)
print('--- original broken layout first 3 ---')
o=16
for i in range(3):
    ts,=struct.unpack_from('<I',b,o); o+=4
    level=b[o]; o+=1
    slen,=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,o); o+=2
    src=b[o:o+slen]; o+=slen
    mlen,=struct.unpack_from('<H',b,o); o+=2
    msg=b[o:o+mlen]; o+=mlen

from pathlib import Path
p = Path('logreader.c')
s = p.read_text()
old = 'if (size - pos >= 4 && bytes_eq(data + pos, "END!", 4)) {'
new = 'if (size - pos == 8 && bytes_eq(data + pos, "END!", 4)) {'
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected footer condition not found')
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
